expectedUsable: The heading outline is sequential (h1 → h2 …) so screen-reader users navigating by heading get a coherent document structure.

violations.expectedFix: Change the three section headings from <h4> to <h2> so the outline goes h1 → h2 without skipping levels; style with CSS rather than by choosing a level.
violations.notes: Included deliberately as a case Layer A DOES catch — this keeps us honest about the scanner's genuine value. pa11y/HTMLCS flags the skipped level under 1.3.1; note that axe's own heading-order rule is best-practice (not a WCAG SC), so this is caught by the pa11y engine in Layer A, not the WCAG-tagged axe pass.
